test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In February 2022, researchers from which institute created a biodegradable nanoparticle that can be used as an alternative to chemical-based insecticides to protect crops from bacterial and fungal diseases.

options.text: Birla Institute of Technology & Science, Pilani

solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (IIT Kanpur) **is one of the premier engineering institutions in India.
 
• IIT Kanpur was **established in 1959** as one of the first IITs in India, set up with the assistance of a consortium of nine universities from the United States.
 
• The institute is located in** Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh**, on a sprawling campus of approximately 1,000 acres.
 
• The** IIT Kanpur Central Library is one of the largest** academic libraries in India, providing extensive resources and support for research and learning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Birla Institute of Technology and Science (BITS)**, Pilani was **established in 1964**.
 
• The main campus is located in **Pilani, Rajasthan**. BITS also has campuses in Goa, Hyderabad, and an **International Campus in Dubai**.
 
• **NIT Rourkela** was **established in 1961** as a Regional Engineering College and was granted **NIT status in 2002**.
 
• The institute is located in **Rourkela, Odisha**, and is situated on a sprawling campus of about 647 acres.
 
• **IISc Bengaluru** was **established in 1909** and is recognized as one of the leading research and higher education institutions in India.
 
• The institute is located in **Bengaluru, Karnataka**, on a lush green campus that spans over 400 acres.
